description: This file defines the EditJobVacancyController class responsible for handling pre-render logic related to editing job vacancies in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It sets up a Vue component with relevant props including vacancy ID, allowed file types, and maximum file size.

classes.name: EditJobVacancyController
classes.description: Controller class for editing job vacancies, extending AbstractVueController and utilizing ConfigServiceTrait.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with props for rendering the job vacancy edit form, retrieving data from the request and configuration service.
